title: Landing Gear — Carbon Brake Wear Pin Datum Relocation and Torque Tube Flange Stiffening

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Relocation of the carbon brake wear pin datum to the torque tube flange and stiffening of the flange attachment, so that the indicated remaining life no longer depends on pressure plate movement.

sections.planning_reason: The delivered wear pin reads against the pressure plate, which moves as the torque tube attachment relaxes, so on a high-cycle aircraft the pin over-reads remaining stack life by about eight per cent. Two operators found brakes at zero remaining life during a wheel change that the pin had passed at the previous turnaround. About a hundred and forty aircraft operating short sectors at high landing weight are exposed. The one-time verification bulletin finds the brakes already past their limit; this bulletin removes the cause.
sections.description: The wear pin datum is moved from the pressure plate to a bracket on the torque tube flange, so that the reading no longer depends on the attachment. The brake regulator is refitted with the pin boss added, the torque tube attachment is stiffened with a doubled flange using swaged collars and plain washers at the eight positions, and the pin scale is re-marked in millimetres remaining rather than in percentage.
sections.accomplishment_summary: This Service Bulletin is accomplished at brake overhaul. The remaining stack life verification bulletin must have been accomplished on the aircraft first. Strip the brake in accordance with the component maintenance manual. Install the doubled flange at the torque tube attachment using the swaged collars LN606496-25 and the plain washers AGS678120-8C at all eight positions. Machine the pin boss on the brake regulator D3240112571209 and install the relocated wear pin bracket. Fit the re-marked pin scale. Refit the pump kit D3240119570323 and the inboard pump 584GB. Reassemble the brake and do the proof pressure test. CAUTION: BRAKES OF THE TWO STANDARDS MUST NOT BE MIXED ON ONE BOGIE. THE WEAR READINGS ARE NOT COMPARABLE. Do AMM-S-32-40-11-200-050-A after installation to establish the baseline reading and record it in the aircraft technical log.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to SOLANO-30, SOLANO-34 and VANTOR-64 aircraft from MSN S00003 to MSN S01068 that carry the delivered wear pin datum. Two aircraft are excluded because they carry a non-standard brake fitted under a supplemental type certificate. Aircraft from MSN S01068 onward are post-modification from build. Revision 02 extends the effectivity to the VANTOR-64 and corrects the flange torque value.
sections.material_note: Kit K3240-1055-01 covers one brake and contains the doubled flange, the collar and washer set, the wear pin bracket and the re-marked scale. Eight kits are needed per aircraft. Lead time is twenty weeks. Removed flanges are returned for relaxation measurement.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next brake overhaul, or within 48 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

revision_history.reason: Effectivity extended to the VANTOR-64; flange torque value corrected at step 4; note added on mixed standards within one bogie
